cycle_report.summary: Cycle 2 successfully extended StoryForge's security hardening from the four primary attack surfaces hardened in Cycle 1 to four secondary surfaces. A SecretRedactionFilter was added to the logging pipeline in web/app.py to prevent SESSION_SECRET, API keys (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY), STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, OAuth client secrets, and SMTP_PASSWORD from ever appearing in log files. A session-secret strength check (_check_session_secret) was added to run.py that blocks startup in production if the default or short (<32 char) secret is detected, and emits a loud warning in DEBUG mode. Database path traversal was closed in config.py via _validate_db_path(), which rejects paths containing '..' components and paths resolving into system directories (/etc/, /proc/, /sys/, /dev/, /root/, /boot/). Output directory injection was blocked in web/routes.py download_project() using Path.relative_to(Config.OUTPUTS_DIR) to ensure no DB-stored zip_path can escape the outputs directory. The regression test suite grew from 24 to 42 tests (categories A-H, 18 new tests). An additional 43-test adversarial battery was run and all passed. Live server on port 5100 confirmed healthy throughout. Final score: 85/85 tests, 0 failures.
